title: zidan kazi
text:
I'm Zidan Kazi

I'm a junior at Stevens Institute of Technology studying Computer Science & Math. I'm currently in Hoboken, New Jersey.

Right now I'm building Mavri. We use fine-tuned diffusion models to make campaign visuals for brands, with tools for production, feedback, and approvals. Some of our clients include Four Seasons, Nespresso, Sephora, and Tiffany & Co.

I also co-founded Relic, a shared memory for teams and AI agents. It connects to the tools a company already uses and makes its decisions, conversations, and context easy to find.

Before that, I interned at Trenchant Analytics, where I built military drone software that brought real-time computer vision, tactical maps, and augmented reality into HoloLens headsets.

Outside of coding

I like trying new foods.

I play League of Legends. I used to be Challenger (top 300 out of 3,000,000).

I also collect CS2 skins. Right now I have a FN Damascus Steel Karambit and MW Snow Leopards.
